name: Shredder Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: an orange paper shredder with a grumpy face, a grey cutting head swallowing paper and spilling shredded strips
entry: It shreds homework, letters and maps. Anything it eats is gone for good.
how: Use a Shredder Blade on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Dark Pulse in this form.
